title: Playboy Magazine August 1986 Brigitte Nielsen Nude Sigourney Weaver Vintage
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, August 1986 issue. Cover feature: Brigitte Nielsen nude, Stallone's leading lady. Also inside: Jackie Gleason interview, 20 Questions with Sigourney Weaver, "Inside the Meese Commission" by Robert Scheer, Dream Boats.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage. Please review photos carefully for exact condition.
